title: When the Colony Falls Anew
author: Coral Iversen
blurb: Emrys Brightwater, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
